summary: Iteration 7 review — backend uploads + edit/duplicate/delete + Library + dashboard sections. Backend: 19/21 pytest pass in /app/backend/tests/test_iteration7.py. Two FAILURES both on GET /api/printables/{id}/pdf when serving the GENERATED template (not the uploaded-PDF path). Uploaded-PDF path works. Root cause: fpdf2's multi_cell defaults to new_x=XPos.RIGHT, so after the first `pdf.multi_cell(0, 12, title, align='C')` at line 604, the cursor sits at the right margin and the second call at line 606 raises FPDFException('Not enough horizontal space to render a single character'). This is deterministic and blocks ALL generated printable PDFs (any title length). Frontend: comprehensive pass — admin login works at /auth (not /login); RecipesAdmin shows 6 recipes with admin-recipe-edit-*/dup-*/del-* data-testids, admin-recipe-photo & admin-recipe-card inputs present, edit prefills existing title correctly, duplicate creates row with '(Copy)' suffix (6→7); PrintablesAdmin has admin-printable-pdf and admin-printable-thumb inputs, generated badge shown; demo family dashboard shows all 3 sections (Family profiles heading, Recipe Books heading), 4 profile-tile-* + 4 profile-edit-* + 4 profile-delete-* + dash-book-{little,junior,teen,adult} + dash-open-library + nav-library link; /app/library shows h1='Recipe Library', all 4 library-section-* headings, 7 recipe cards, tier filter chips; sample recipe without recipe_card_file_id correctly hides recipe-card-download button; fresh signup (newfam+it7-*@example.com/password12345) lands on /app with profiles=0, profiles-empty marker visible, 4 book tiles still visible; fresh family /app/library shows 'Active membership required — Activate membership' (correct 402 handling). Regression: GET /api/flags, /api/recipes/samples (3 items), /api/printables list, /api/gift-certificate/pdf, /api/admin/codes+/redeem all 200. TestUploads (recipe_photo/recipe_card/printable_pdf/printable_thumbnail) all 200 for admin. RecipeAdmin PATCH+duplicate+card download+402/404 all 200 as expected.

critical.issue: 500 InternalServerError from fpdf2 `Not enough horizontal space to render a single character`. Reason: server.py line 604 uses pdf.multi_cell(0, 12, title, align='C') which in fpdf2 defaults to new_x=XPos.RIGHT — cursor ends at right margin, so line 606 multi_cell has 0 width available. Every generated printable PDF is broken regardless of title length. Reproduce: create any printable without pdf_file_id then GET /printables/{id}/pdf. Fix: pass `new_x=XPos.LMARGIN, new_y=YPos.NEXT` to each multi_cell call (or add pdf.ln(0)/set_x(pdf.l_margin) between them). Also affects the description multi_cell later in the same handler.

action_items: Fix FPDF multi_cell cursor bug in server.py::printable_pdf (lines 604-608) — use new_x=XPos.LMARGIN or reset x between multi_cell calls. Re-run test_iteration7.py::TestPrintables::test_pdf_generated_when_no_pdf_file_id and test_long_title_wraps to verify.

Frontend hot-reload sometimes leaves the last preview blank until frontend is restarted via supervisorctl — I restarted once during this run.
rca of the issue: fpdf2 (installed as `fpdf` module import path but v2 semantics) changed multi_cell default cursor position from BOTTOM/LEFT (fpdf1) to RIGHT/NEXT. When width=0 (fill to right margin), the resulting cursor.x == right-margin, so any subsequent multi_cell with width=0 has zero available horizontal space and raises FPDFException. Mitigation: pass explicit new_x/new_y args on every multi_cell in printable_pdf and recipe_pdf handlers.
